judgments.item: 413 whole routine and actual two materials
judgments.reason: The stated equilibrium, no-reaction/no-loss assumptions make a capacity calculation in grams solute per100g WATER valid. Denominator is solvent mass, not solution mass. A clear solution can be exactly saturated, and stirring after equilibrium does not increase the limit. Temperature change without new solubility data cannot establish direction or amount of change. The full supplied cases demand mass/capacity/residue judgments and the water-addition balance. Both language versions express the same demand; synthetic data are not empirical execution evidence.

judgments.decision: KEEP distinct ordinary routines; no substitutive mastery inference
judgments.reason: ac1bc adds dissolution stoichiometry, activities/concentration approximation, Ksp, Q, common-ion and qualitative coupling. Its two actual full cases correctly distinguish1:1 from1:2 salts and free ion concentration from total dissolved content. They do not elicit the whole413 mass-per-solvent capacity, residue and water-addition routine. Conversely413 does not cover dynamic ion balance or Ksp. Shared saturation vocabulary does not establish equivalence. Full ac1bc mastery cannot create413 mastery, and its current20f MWG prerequisite need not be replaced by a universal whole413 prerequisite solely to fix metadata.

judgments.decision: Do not claim full413 or whole composite coverage
judgments.reason: The mandatory row addresses solutions/solubility across solid, liquid and gas solutes and multiple solvents plus mass and volume fractions. The whole413 data routine does not cover this entire composite or experimental solution preparation. A shared conceptual contribution could be partial, but it cannot by itself justify relabelling the specific quantitative saturation routine as an explicit mandatory full row. Existing other carrier/source duties must remain exact.

judgments.item: HE G9 actual facultative row, printed12
judgments.reason: The optional temperature-dependence row explicitly includes saturated/unsaturated and concentrated/dilute solutions, solubility graphs and crystallization experiments. Whole413 supports the saturation and supplied quantitative-data aspect. It does not itself teach complete temperature graphs, all concentration comparisons or real crystallization execution; preserve those residual duties and the official optional status. This is a real HE curriculum fit, not a TH-only-only impossibility.

judgments.decision: KEEP ac1bc direct fit;413 at most partial foundation
judgments.reason: The KL interpretation row is in the increased-level LK section. ac1bc directly operationalizes the ionic equilibrium and KL interpretation with correct stoichiometric safeguards.413 alone lacks KL and dynamic ionic content, so cannot replace ac1bc or receive exact whole LK-row coverage. Source level must stay LK without globally changing GK/LK tags used legitimately elsewhere.

The paper examines bounded ethanol/ester/equilibrium/energy/source/physiology work, not g-per100g saturation or Ksp. Its coveredGoalIds correctly omit both413 and ac1bc. Course-admission requirements are distinct from direct test coverage:413 and ac1bc can legitimately remain course completion prerequisites when authored HE targets apply. A paper pass creates only endpoint mastery, not any of230 underlying goals. The current TH-only compiled413 cannot establish scientific inadmissibility; it identifies missing HE source applicability evidence needing repair.

judgments.decision: Do not silently drop legitimate optional413 target/duty
judgments.reason: Official optional status is retained. Inclusion in the interim SkillPilot authored target does not claim universal mandatory HE teaching or persisted learner topic choice. Because an actual HE optional row fits413, removing it solely to eliminate the APV blocker would be an unjustified policy narrowing. A genuine optional source contribution and correctly authored stage/course target/support roles are the bounded repair.
